label: Severe constraints
action: Route notification through international bodies rather than national channels; coordinate with local law enforcement; run active rumour management from first notice

label: Significant constraints
action: Notify national authorities and international bodies together; prepare rumour-management statements before announcement; coordinate with local law enforcement

label: Moderate constraints
action: Notify national authorities directly; consult them on the timing of the announcement; monitor for rumours and correct them as they arise

label: Minor constraints
action: Notify national authorities directly; announce through official and media channels; monitor for rumours

label: Favourable conditions
action: Notify and announce through normal official and media channels; routine monitoring

label: Information through international channels
action: Expect first information from international bodies rather than national ones; expect heightened law enforcement activity; expect frequent official corrections of false reports

label: Coordinated official information
action: Expect national and international bodies to speak together; expect heightened law enforcement activity; expect prepared official statements

label: National official information
action: Expect national authorities to inform the public; expect corrections of false reports as they appear

label: Normal official information
action: Expect the announcement through official and media channels
